VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: ATT

The CI log (ATT) confirms 88 tests pass, satisfying criterion (2). However, there is no admissible evidence that criterion (1)—the rounding drift bug is actually fixed—has been verified. The self-report claiming the fix is SELF-class and not independently corroborated. Critically, a passing test suite only proves the bug is fixed if there is a test that specifically exercises the rounding drift condition; the evidence does not show such a test exists or was added. The 88 passing tests may all predate the fix and never cover the netting rounding case. Absent attested proof that the specific defect is addressed, the acceptance criteria are not demonstrably met.
